# Bottom sheet

[← Accordion](accordion.md) · [All examples](../EXAMPLES.md) · [Flip card →](flip_card.md)

<img src="../gifs/bottom_sheet.gif" width="300" alt="Bottom sheet">

A sheet slides up over a dimming backdrop. Tap the backdrop, press Done, or drag the sheet down to close it.

Reanimated docs: [examples/bottomsheet](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-reanimated/examples/bottomsheet)

## What to look at

- `progress` runs from 1 (closed) to 0 (open) with `withTiming`; the sheet slides by `progress × 2 × height` and the backdrop fades with `1 − progress`.
- A drag adds an offset. On release, the sheet closes if it was dragged a third of the way or flung, and otherwise springs back keeping the drag's velocity.
- The switches inside are the `AnimatedSwitch` from the Switch example.

## Code

The screen comes first, then the components it uses. Shared helpers (`DemoPage`, `Section`, `Stage`, `Palette`, `Buttons`, `ChoiceChips`, `LabeledSlider`) live in `example_app/lib/src/common/` and only do layout.

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

import '../components/animated_switch.dart';
import '../components/bottom_sheet.dart';

/// examples/bottomsheet: a sheet slides up over a dimmed backdrop. Tap the
/// backdrop, press the button or drag the sheet down to close it.
class BottomSheetScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const BottomSheetScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<BottomSheetScreen> createState() => _BottomSheetScreenState();
}

class _BottomSheetScreenState extends State<BottomSheetScreen> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final isOpen = useSharedValue(false);
  late final notifications = useSharedValue(true);
  late final darkMode = useSharedValue(false);

  void toggleSheet() => isOpen.value = !isOpen.value;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Bottom sheet')),
        body: Stack(
          children: [
            Positioned(
              left: 0,
              top: 0,
              right: 0,
              bottom: 0,
              child: Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const Text('docs: examples/bottomsheet',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Color(0xFF8A8FA3))),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    ElevatedButton(onPressed: toggleSheet, child: const Text('Toggle bottom sheet')),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Positioned(
              left: 0,
              top: 0,
              right: 0,
              bottom: 0,
              child: AnimatedBottomSheet(
                isOpen: isOpen,
                toggleSheet: toggleSheet,
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    const Text('Settings', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                    _row('Notifications', notifications),
                    _row('Dark mode', darkMode),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                    ElevatedButton(onPressed: toggleSheet, child: const Text('Done')),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

  Widget _row(String label, SharedValue<bool> value) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
        child: Row(children: [
          Expanded(child: Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16))),
          AnimatedSwitch(value: value, onPress: () => value.value = !value.value),
        ]),
      );
}
```

### `lib/src/components/animated_switch.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

/// The Reanimated site's `Switch`: the track's color is interpolateColor'd
/// between the off and on colors and the thumb slides across, both with
/// withTiming (400 ms). Track size is measured, so any width and height work.
class AnimatedSwitch extends StatefulWidget {
  const AnimatedSwitch({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.onPress,
    this.width = 64,
    this.height = 36,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
    this.trackColors = (on: const Color(0xFF82CAB2), off: const Color(0xFFFA7F7C)),
  });

  final SharedValue<bool> value;
  final VoidCallback onPress;
  final double width;
  final double height;
  final Duration duration;
  final ({Color on, Color off}) trackColors;

  @override
  State<AnimatedSwitch> createState() => _AnimatedSwitchState();
}

class _AnimatedSwitchState extends State<AnimatedSwitch> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final height = useSharedValue(widget.height);
  late final width = useSharedValue(widget.width);

  late final trackColor = useDerivedAnimation(
    widget.value.value ? widget.trackColors.on : widget.trackColors.off,
    () => withTiming(
      interpolateColor(widget.value.value ? 1 : 0, [0, 1], [widget.trackColors.off, widget.trackColors.on]),
      duration: widget.duration,
    ),
  );
  late final thumbX = useDerivedAnimation(
    0.0,
    () => withTiming(
      interpolate(widget.value.value ? 1 : 0, [0, 1], [0, width.value - height.value]),
      duration: widget.duration,
    ),
  );

  late final trackAnimatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        backgroundColor: trackColor.value,
        borderRadius: height.value / 2,
      ));
  late final thumbAnimatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        translateX: thumbX.value,
        borderRadius: height.value / 2,
      ));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => GestureDetector(
        onTap: widget.onPress,
        child: AnimatedView(
          onLayout: (size) {
            height.value = size.height;
            width.value = size.width;
          },
          style: Styles([
            AnimatedStyle(width: widget.width, height: widget.height),
            trackAnimatedStyle,
          ]),
          child: Align(
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(widget.height * 0.08),
              child: AnimatedView(
                style: Styles([
                  AnimatedStyle(
                    width: widget.height * 0.84,
                    height: widget.height * 0.84,
                    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFFFFFFF),
                  ),
                  thumbAnimatedStyle,
                ]),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}
```

### `lib/src/components/bottom_sheet.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

/// The Reanimated site's `AnimatedBottomSheet`: progress runs from 1 (closed) to 0
/// (open) with withTiming; the sheet slides by progress × 2 × its measured
/// height and the backdrop fades with 1 − progress. The sheet can also be
/// dragged down and flung closed.
class AnimatedBottomSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const AnimatedBottomSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.isOpen,
    required this.toggleSheet,
    required this.child,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
  });

  final SharedValue<bool> isOpen;
  final VoidCallback toggleSheet;
  final Widget child;
  final Duration duration;

  @override
  State<AnimatedBottomSheet> createState() => _AnimatedBottomSheetState();
}

class _AnimatedBottomSheetState extends State<AnimatedBottomSheet> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final height = useSharedValue(0.0);
  late final progress = useDerivedAnimation(
    1.0,
    () => withTiming(widget.isOpen.value ? 0.0 : 1.0, duration: widget.duration),
  );

  /// Extra offset while the user drags the sheet down.
  late final drag = useSharedValue(0.0);

  late final sheetStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        translateY: progress.value * 2 * height.value + drag.value,
      ));
  late final backdropStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        opacity: (1 - progress.value) * (1 - (drag.value / (height.value + 1)).clamp(0.0, 1.0)),
      ));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Stack(
        children: [
          Positioned(
            left: 0,
            top: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            // While closed the backdrop lets touches through, as the
            // site's zIndex switch does.
            child: ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
              valueListenable: widget.isOpen,
              builder: (context, open, _) => IgnorePointer(
                ignoring: !open,
                child: GestureDetector(
                  onTap: widget.toggleSheet,
                  child: AnimatedView(
                    // Sized explicitly: a view with no size of its own collapses.
                    style: Styles([
                      AnimatedStyle(
                        width: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width,
                        height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height,
                        backgroundColor: const Color(0x4D000000),
                      ),
                      backdropStyle,
                    ]),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Positioned(
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            child: GestureDetector(
              onVerticalDragUpdate: (d) => drag.value = (drag.value + d.delta.dy).clamp(0.0, double.infinity),
              onVerticalDragEnd: (d) {
                final v = d.velocity.pixelsPerSecond.dy;
                if (drag.value > height.value / 3 || v > 800) {
                  widget.toggleSheet();
                  drag.set(withTiming(0, duration: widget.duration));
                } else {
                  drag.set(withSpring(0, velocity: v));
                }
              },
              child: AnimatedView(
                onLayout: (size) => height.value = size.height,
                style: Styles([
                  const AnimatedStyle(backgroundColor: Color(0xFFF8F9FF), borderRadius: 24),
                  sheetStyle,
                ]),
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 12, 24, 40),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                      Center(
                        child: Container(
                          width: 40,
                          height: 5,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: const Color(0xFFC9CCD8), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3)),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      widget.child,
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
}
```
